## WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 19TH | 7PM

### DJ JANIKA TENN

**From London to Ibiza. From New York to Miami** 🌎

Producer & DJ Janika Tenn returns to Elia this Wednesday, bringing her signature house sounds back to the waterfront.

One night. 7PM. Don’t miss this.

[RESERVE NOW](/reservations)

### August at Elia on the River:

[BOOK NOW](https://www.opentable.com/r/elia-miami?ot_source=Instagram)

**SUNSET HOUR**
**MONDAY TO FRIDAY**
**3 - 6 PM**

Glass of Whispering Angel & Bruschetta
$18

Bottle of Whispering Angel & Burrata
$60

#### TIPSY TEA THURSDAYS WITH APEROL

**EVERY THURSDAY**
**3 - 6 PM**

What happens when Thirsty Thursday meets Afternoon Tea? You will get Tipsy Tea!

Come and spill the tea with us every Thursday
3:00 to 6:00 PM. With three-tier bites towers, spritzes, live entertainment, & riverfront views designed to make Thursday afternoons
feel a little more special.

## Where Water Meets Sunset

Elia on the River offers an unparalleled dining experience on the river, combining stunning views with a carefully curated menu showcasing a harmonious blend of coastal flavors and locally sourced ingredients.

Guests can look forward to enjoying their meals surrounded by luxurious imported marbles and a stunning hand-painted mural masterpiece, all while taking in panoramic views of passing yachts and breathtaking sunsets.

**In line with local health regulations, pets are not permitted at Elia. We truly appreciate your understanding.**

[RESERVE](https://www.opentable.com/r/elia-miami?ot_source=Instagram)

### Dock & Dine

Perched right on the water, we’re the perfect destination to dock your boat and enjoy comforting coastal cuisine and warm riverfront atmosphere.

* How do I reserve?

  Docking with us is now easier than ever.

  Use the link below to access River Landing on Dockwa, then search “River Landing” to send your request.
* What are the fees?

  The docking fee is waived on tables over $500, otherwise, the fee is $5 per foot per hour.

[CONTACT CONCIERGE](https://dockwa.com)

### A Little Luxury… Give the Gift of Elia on the River

Our Elia on the River gift certificates can be issued in any amount, making them the perfect way to treat someone to cocktails by the water, a romantic dinner, or a night out with friends.

A beautiful, effortless gift for every occasion.

[ELIA GIFT CARDS](https://order.toasttab.com/egiftcards/elia-restaurant-1440-nw-north-river-drive-195)

### “Each dish is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring a memorable and delightful meal.”

— Executive Chef, *Elia*

If you prefer not to be featured, please notify staff.

Thank you!

  Mondays | 7:00 PM

# Tipsy Tea Thursdays with Aperol

### Come Spill the Tea

### **What happens when Thirsty Thursday meets Afternoon Tea? You will get Tipsy Tea!**

#### **Thursdays | 3 PM – 6 PM**

#### Three-Tier Towers | Spritzes | Live Entertainment | River Views

**TIPSY TEA (/ˈtɪpsi tiː/) (noun)**

**A social gathering featuring savory & sweet towers, spritzes, and good conversation,
traditionally enjoyed on Thursday afternoons by the river.**

You can choose between River Tower ($55 per person) or Sunset Tower ($85 per person).
PS! * *Caviar Bites are only included with Sunset Tower.
For reservation $25 pre-payment is required.*

Elia on the River is adding a playful twist on two beloved traditions - the classic afternoon tea experience and everyone’s favorite excuse to start the weekend early.

Every Thursday from 3 PM to 6 PM, the Miami River becomes the place to be.
With three-tier towers, spritzes, live entertainment, and riverfront views designed to make Thursday afternoons
feel a little more special.

#### **But forget the teacups.** At Tipsy Tea, towers arrive stacked with sweet & savory bites, Spritzes replace the tea service, and the soundtrack will be upbeat.

### Dress code: Italian Riviera Chic

**Tipsy Tea is available via online booking only!*

[LEARN MORE & BOOK](https://www.opentable.com/booking/experiences-availability?rid=1356508&restref=1356508&experienceId=760501&utm_source=external&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=shared)

[Image: 4T4A2786.jpg]

---

#### Signature experiences:

**THE RIVER TOWER** (90-minute experience)

• One three-tier tower per two guests;

• Choice of two cocktails per person.

**THE SUNSET TOWER** (90-minute experience)

• Premium luxury tower

• 90-minute bottomless spritz package

Tipsy Tea was created to turn Thursdays into an occasion.

Think less London & more Miami. Less tea party & more riverfront cocktails, spritzes, and music.

**THURSDAYS: 3 PM – 6 PM, AT ELIA ON THE RIVER**

**Because sometimes tea is better a little tipsy.**

* *Tipsy Tea Thursdays is available by reservation only & must be booked in advance.*
*Walk-ins and same-day accommodations for the experience are not available.*
